# X08 cycle 3a: the same users, same UID and GID, new GeneratedUIDs, for the
# recreation on g1 (boot 7), a system disk that never had them.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbr1 621 621 97432B56-D717-4489-B514-BDC4DDE9828A C3F2866B-A2E8-4FB0-B971-5AD378EE22D7
wbr2 622 622 DBD253F2-DD49-4505-B5FA-1935D6346E8E 82BD1E5A-33AA-45D2-A36C-8E11CA4DEB41
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbr1 U2=wbr2 VOLNAME=WBHost
# X08 cycle 2: what wb-guestd would do at start. Find the data volume by
# its name ($VOLNAME), move it from wherever Disk Arbitration put it to the
# fixed mount point $H outside /Volumes (cycle 1: a /Volumes point can't be
# mounted on again), with nobrowse, nosuid and nodev unless SUID=1, and
# with ownership on: the owners mount option, then diskutil enableOwnership,
# which an external volume needs again on a new system disk. Throwaway.
set -u
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
vol=$(diskutil info "$VOLNAME" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Device Identifier/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
echo "volume: ${vol:-none}"
[ -n "$vol" ] || exit 1
echo "before: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol " || echo 'not mounted')"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Locked|FileVault'
diskutil unmount "$vol" >/dev/null 2>&1
# An unmount locks a passphrase volume again, so unlock after it.
if [ -n "${PASS:-}" ] && diskutil info "$vol" | grep -q 'Locked: *Yes'; then
  printf '%s' "$PASS" | diskutil apfs unlockVolume "$vol" -stdinpassphrase -nomount
  diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Locked'
fi
mkdir -p "$H"
opts=nobrowse,nosuid,nodev,owners
[ "${SUID:-0}" = 1 ] && opts=nobrowse,owners
diskutil mount -mountOptions "$opts" -mountPoint "$H" "$vol"
echo "mounted: $(mount | grep " $H ")"
diskutil enableOwnership "$H"
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME mount $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "after: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol ")"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Mount Point'
ls -lan "$H"

# X08 cycle 3a: the same users, same UID and GID, new GeneratedUIDs, for the
# recreation on g1 (boot 7), a system disk that never had them.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbr1 621 621 97432B56-D717-4489-B514-BDC4DDE9828A C3F2866B-A2E8-4FB0-B971-5AD378EE22D7
wbr2 622 622 DBD253F2-DD49-4505-B5FA-1935D6346E8E 82BD1E5A-33AA-45D2-A36C-8E11CA4DEB41
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbr1 U2=wbr2 VOLNAME=WBHost
# X08: create the project users from host state ($USERS, $HOMES, prepended
# by the host). Each gets its own group, a fixed UID, GID and GeneratedUID,
# no password, no admin, hidden, and a home on the data volume. An existing
# home is kept as it is (the recreation case). Throwaway.
set -u
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
chown root:wheel $HOMES
chmod 755 $HOMES
echo "$USERS" | while read -r n uid gid ugu ggu; do
  [ -n "$n" ] || continue
  # GeneratedUID first: dscl -create refuses to replace the one that
  # opendirectoryd assigns when the record is made without it.
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n GeneratedUID $ggu
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n PrimaryGroupID $gid
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n RealName "x08 $n"
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n Password '*'
  dscl . -create /Users/$n GeneratedUID $ugu
  dscl . -create /Users/$n UniqueID $uid
  dscl . -create /Users/$n PrimaryGroupID $gid
  dscl . -create /Users/$n NFSHomeDirectory $HOMES/$n
  dscl . -create /Users/$n UserShell /bin/zsh
  dscl . -create /Users/$n RealName "x08 $n"
  dscl . -create /Users/$n Password '*'
  dscl . -create /Users/$n IsHidden 1
  dscl . -append /Groups/$n GroupMembership $n
  if [ -d $HOMES/$n ]; then
    echo "$n: home exists, kept"
  else
    createhomedir -c -u $n 2>&1 | tail -1
    chmod 700 $HOMES/$n
  fi
done
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME users $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "$USERS" | while read -r n uid gid ugu ggu; do
  [ -n "$n" ] || continue
  id $n
  dscl . -read /Users/$n UniqueID PrimaryGroupID GeneratedUID NFSHomeDirectory
  dscl . -read /Groups/$n PrimaryGroupID GeneratedUID
  dsmemberutil getuuid -U $n
  dsmemberutil checkmembership -U $n -G admin

done

# X08 cycle 3a: the same users, same UID and GID, new GeneratedUIDs, for the
# recreation on g1 (boot 7), a system disk that never had them.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbr1 621 621 97432B56-D717-4489-B514-BDC4DDE9828A C3F2866B-A2E8-4FB0-B971-5AD378EE22D7
wbr2 622 622 DBD253F2-DD49-4505-B5FA-1935D6346E8E 82BD1E5A-33AA-45D2-A36C-8E11CA4DEB41
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbr1 U2=wbr2 VOLNAME=WBHost
# X08: a comparable snapshot of the homes on the data volume: numeric owner,
# group, mode, flags, size, ACL (as ls prints it), xattrs, and a checksum of
# every regular file. Times are left out: they differ by design. Throwaway.
set -u
H=${H:-/Volumes/wbhomes}
cd $H || exit 1
find ${U1:-wbp1} ${U2:-wbp2} -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r p; do
  st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf %z' "$p")
  case $(stat -f '%HT' "$p") in
    "Regular File") sum=$(shasum -a 256 "$p" | cut -c1-16) ;;
    "Symbolic Link") sum="-> $(readlink "$p")" ;;
    *) sum=- ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$p" ] && st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf' "$p")
  echo "$p $st $sum"
  ls -lde "$p" | sed -n '2,$p' | sed 's/^/    acl/'
  xattr "$p" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    xattr /'
done

# X08 cycle 3b: same users, new GeneratedUIDs, for g1 (boot 7).
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbs1 631 631 8209290E-5507-4660-AD8C-64D9066EAE64 EC31115F-A0F9-470F-84E2-316C7235DD2A
wbs2 632 632 1A829D10-93F5-44D3-AE3E-755C545AF8FB EFCB1CCC-7847-4FB8-9C45-B392EEA2F0A3
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhfs
H=$HOMES U1=wbs1 U2=wbs2 VOLNAME=WBHfs
# X08: a comparable snapshot of the homes on the data volume: numeric owner,
# group, mode, flags, size, ACL (as ls prints it), xattrs, and a checksum of
# every regular file. Times are left out: they differ by design. Throwaway.
set -u
H=${H:-/Volumes/wbhomes}
cd $H || exit 1
find ${U1:-wbp1} ${U2:-wbp2} -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r p; do
  st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf %z' "$p")
  case $(stat -f '%HT' "$p") in
    "Regular File") sum=$(shasum -a 256 "$p" | cut -c1-16) ;;
    "Symbolic Link") sum="-> $(readlink "$p")" ;;
    *) sum=- ;;
  esac
  [ -d "$p" ] && st=$(stat -f '%u %g %Sp %Sf' "$p")
  echo "$p $st $sum"
  ls -lde "$p" | sed -n '2,$p' | sed 's/^/    acl/'
  xattr "$p" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    xattr /'
done
